target_selection_rule: Select the last successful Analysis Agent result whose operation metadata is count or distinct_count. Record the resolved step ID. If no such result exists, the scheduled injection is not applied and is excluded from the M5 applied-injection denominator.
expected_detector_target: V2.4 numerical_verification check for the resolved step ID
self_correction_reason: The frozen V2.5 strategy only reconciles a qualifying single-step ID mismatch; it does not repair an incorrect numerical intermediate value. V2.5 must terminate safely without claiming a correction.

denominator_rules.M5: Actual number of successfully applied scheduled injections, not all 100 benchmark cases.
denominator_rules.M6: Actual number of injected errors detected by V2.4 and presented to V2.5 for correction; preserve zero-denominator as N/A.

coverage_limit: This safe schedule covers aggregation, time analysis, and adversarial/error-oriented cases at Easy and Medium difficulty. Hard cases require operations/dependency semantics for which the current V2.3/V2.4 implementation does not provide an independently checkable numerical target; no hard case is forced into this schedule.
